papers.title: Chronological age and failure to rescue after colorectal cancer surgery: A multicentre cohort study
papers.authors: Cwaliński T, Kazanowski M, Piątkowski J, Ciesielski M, Januszkiewicz M, Bigus Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Whether advancing chronological age is associated more strongly with serious postoperative events or with survival after an event remains uncertain.
AIMS: To compare the association of chronological age with major postoperative events and failure to rescue after colorectal cancer surgery.
METHODS: We analyzed 1,124 adults treated at five Polish centers between January 2022 and August 2025. Major events were Clavien-Dindo ≥grade IIIa; failure to rescue was cumulative 90-day death after such an event. Chronological age was analysed per 10-year increase. Multivariable logistic regression examined major events and Firth regression examined failure to rescue.
RESULTS: Major events occurred in 145 patients; failure to rescue was evaluable in 134 and occurred in 24. Chronological age was not associated with major events (adjusted odds ratio per decade 1.09, 95% confidence interval 0.89-1.33) or nonfatal major morbidity. Failure-to-rescue odds increased per decade (odds ratio 2.02, 95% confidence interval 1.21-3.63); model-standardized probabilities were 11.1% at age 65 and 32.5% at age 85 years. Sensitivity analyses were directionally consistent, but the interval included no association when every model-eligible missing post-event outcome was assigned to death.
DISCUSSION: The chronological-age gradient was concentrated in survival after a serious event. Frailty and physiological reserve were not measured; reduced reserve remains a plausible explanation rather than a demonstrated mechanism.
CONCLUSIONS: Chronological age may help identify patients who warrant intensified postoperative surveillance and early escalation, while formal geriatric and frailty assessment remains necessary to characterize biological vulnerability.
papers.title_zh: 實際年齡與大腸直腸癌手術後搶救失敗之關聯：多中心世代研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：隨著實際年齡增加，究竟與術後嚴重併發症的發生較相關，還是與併發症發生後的存活較相關，目前仍不確定。目的：比較實際年齡與大腸直腸癌手術後主要術後事件及搶救失敗（failure to rescue）之關聯。方法：我們分析了2022年1月至2025年8月間於波蘭五個醫學中心接受治療的1,124名成人病患。主要事件定義為Clavien-Dindo分級≥IIIa；搶救失敗定義為發生此類事件後90天內累積死亡。實際年齡以每增加10歲為分析單位。以多變量邏輯迴歸分析主要事件，以Firth迴歸分析搶救失敗。結果：145名病患發生主要事件；搶救失敗可評估者為134人，其中24人發生。實際年齡與主要事件無關聯（校正後每十年勝算比1.09，95%信賴區間0.89-1.33），與非致命性主要併發症亦無關。但搶救失敗的勝算隨每十年增加而上升（勝算比2.02，95%信賴區間1.21-3.63）；模型標準化機率在65歲時為11.1%，在85歲時為32.5%。敏感性分析方向一致，但當所有模型可納入的事件後結果缺失值均被歸類為死亡時，信賴區間則涵蓋無關聯之可能。討論：實際年齡的梯度效應集中在嚴重事件發生後的存活上。本研究並未測量衰弱（frailty）與生理儲備，降低的生理儲備仍只是合理的推測機制，而非已證實的機制。結論：實際年齡可能有助於辨識需要加強術後監測與及早升級處置的病患，但仍需進行正式的老年醫學與衰弱評估，以描述生物學上的脆弱性。
papers.score_reason: 搶救失敗事件數僅24例、信賴區間寬、最差情境敏感性分析結果跨越無效線，加上單一國家資料，證據強度有限但臨床概念具參考價值。

papers.action: 對高齡病患一旦發生Clavien-Dindo≥IIIa併發症，應降低升級治療（如轉ICU、提前會診）的門檻，並輔以正式衰弱評估而非僅憑年齡。

papers.title: CT-based multi-station lymph-node radiomics for preoperative prediction of lymph node metastasis in colorectal cancer: a proof-of-concept comparison with primary-tumor radiomics
papers.authors: Lin Z, Wang J, Chen H, Bao Q, Xu M, Yang S
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Accurate preoperative prediction of lymph node metastasis (LNM) in colorectal cancer remains challenging using conventional CT assessment. This proof-of-concept study compared CT-based multi-station lymph-node radiomics with primary-tumor radiomics for patient-level preoperative prediction of LNM.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This single-center retrospective study included patients with pathologically confirmed colorectal cancer who underwent preoperative contrast-enhanced CT and surgical resection. Patients were divided into training and validation cohorts. Radiomics features were extracted from the primary tumor and visible regional lymph nodes across multiple nodal stations. Three radiomics strategies were developed and compared: primary-tumor radiomics, multi-station lymph-node radiomics, and combined radiomics. Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration analysis, decision curve analysis, and five-fold cross-validation. Pairwise AUCs were compared using the DeLong test. A clinical-radiomic model was further constructed by integrating the optimal radiomics strategy with preoperative clinical variables.
RESULTS: In the validation cohort, the multi-station lymph-node radiomics model outperformed the primary-tumor radiomics model for predicting LNM (AUC, 0.864 versus 0.637; p = 0.0055). The combined radiomics model achieved an AUC of 0.840, without significant improvement over the lymph-node model (p = 0.2211). After integration with clinical variables, the clinical-radiomic model achieved an AUC of 0.879.
CONCLUSION: CT-based multi-station lymph-node radiomics showed significantly higher validation performance than primary-tumor radiomics for patient-level preoperative LNM prediction in colorectal cancer. However, this single-center proof-of-concept model is not ready for direct clinical implementation and requires multicenter external validation before clinical translation.
KEY POINTS: Question Can CT-based multi-station lymph-node radiomics improve preoperative nodal metastasis prediction beyond primary-tumor radiomics in patients with surgically treated colorectal cancer? Findings Multi-station lymph-node radiomics achieved higher validation performance than primary-tumor radiomics for patient-level prediction of pathological lymph-node metastasis in colorectal cancer. Relevance statement CT-based multi-station lymph-node radiomics may support individualized preoperative nodal risk stratification in colorectal cancer, but multicenter validation and prospective evaluation are required before clinical translation.

papers.title_zh: 基於CT之多站淋巴結放射組學用於大腸直腸癌術前淋巴結轉移預測：與原發腫瘤放射組學之概念驗證比較研究
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：使用傳統CT評估大腸直腸癌術前淋巴結轉移（LNM）仍具挑戰性。本概念驗證研究比較以CT為基礎之多站淋巴結放射組學與原發腫瘤放射組學，用於病人層級之術前LNM預測。材料與方法：此為單中心回溯性研究，納入術前接受顯影劑增強CT及手術切除、病理確診之大腸直腸癌病人。病人分為訓練組與驗證組。從原發腫瘤及多個淋巴結站之可見區域淋巴結萃取放射組學特徵。開發並比較三種放射組學策略：原發腫瘤放射組學、多站淋巴結放射組學、合併放射組學。模型表現以接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC）、校正分析、決策曲線分析及五折交叉驗證評估。成對AUC以DeLong檢定比較。進一步將最佳放射組學策略與術前臨床變項整合，建立臨床-放射組學模型。結果：在驗證組中，多站淋巴結放射組學模型預測LNM之表現優於原發腫瘤放射組學模型（AUC 0.864 vs 0.637；p = 0.0055）。合併放射組學模型AUC達0.840，相較於淋巴結模型並無顯著改善（p = 0.2211）。整合臨床變項後，臨床-放射組學模型AUC達0.879。結論：以CT為基礎之多站淋巴結放射組學在大腸直腸癌病人層級術前LNM預測之驗證表現顯著優於原發腫瘤放射組學。然而，此單中心概念驗證模型尚未準備好直接用於臨床，須經多中心外部驗證後方可轉譯至臨床應用。重點：問題——以CT為基礎之多站淋巴結放射組學是否能改善手術治療之大腸直腸癌病人術前淋巴結轉移預測，優於原發腫瘤放射組學？發現——多站淋巴結放射組學在病人層級預測病理淋巴結轉移之驗證表現優於原發腫瘤放射組學。相關性聲明——CT多站淋巴結放射組學或可協助大腸直腸癌之個人化術前淋巴結風險分層，但臨床轉譯前仍需多中心驗證及前瞻性評估。

papers.title: Single-port robotic and conventional multiport laparoscopic colectomy for colon cancer: an overlap-weighted comparison of perioperative and oncologic outcomes
papers.authors: Jo M, Lee H, Kim H, Chung S, Noh G
papers.abstract: Comparative evidence for single-port colectomy with robotic system remains limited, particularly for long-term cancer control. We compared perioperative recovery and oncologic outcomes following single-port robotic surgery (SPRS) and conventional multiport laparoscopic surgery (CMLS) in colon cancer. This retrospective study screened 710 patients treated surgically between March 2019 and February 2025. The analytic cohort was balanced with propensity score overlap weighting (PSOW), after which operative, postoperative, pathologic, and survival data were compared. The analysis included 472 patients (142 SPRS and 330 CMLS). PSOW balanced the four covariates specified in the propensity model. SPRS had a longer mean operative time (255.0 vs. 197.5 min, p < 0.001), but no patient required open conversion (0.0% vs. 3.1%, p = 0.011). Compared with CMLS, SPRS was followed by earlier passage of flatus (2.4 vs. 3.4 days), earlier tolerance of a soft diet (3.3 vs. 4.8 days), and a shorter postoperative stay (7.5 vs. 8.5 days) (all p ≤ 0.001). Pain scores through postoperative day 5 were lower after SPRS (all p < 0.001), whereas complication rates and pathologic measures were similar. Three-year relapse-free survival (RFS) was 95.2% after SPRS and 95.1% after CMLS (p = 0.835); the corresponding overall survival (OS) were 97.2% and 94.8% (p = 0.104). Surgical modality was not an independent predictor of RFS or OS. Within the available follow-up, SPRS provided oncologic results comparable to CMLS while being associated with less postoperative pain and enhanced recovery. These data support SPRS as a feasible approach for selected patients with colon cancer.

papers.title_zh: 單孔機器人手術與傳統多孔腹腔鏡大腸癌切除術：以重疊權重傾向分數法比較圍術期與腫瘤學結果
papers.abstract_zh: 單孔機器人大腸切除術（SPRS）的比較性證據仍有限，尤其是長期癌症控制方面。本研究比較大腸癌病人接受單孔機器人手術（SPRS）與傳統多孔腹腔鏡手術（CMLS）後的圍術期恢復與腫瘤學結果。此回溯性研究篩選2019年3月至2025年2月間接受手術治療的710名病人。分析世代以傾向分數重疊權重法（PSOW）進行平衡，之後比較手術、術後、病理及存活資料。分析納入472名病人（142名SPRS，330名CMLS）。PSOW平衡了傾向分數模型中指定的四個共變項。SPRS平均手術時間較長（255.0 vs 197.5分鐘，p<0.001），但無病人需轉為開腹手術（0.0% vs 3.1%，p=0.011）。與CMLS相比，SPRS術後排氣較早（2.4 vs 3.4天）、較早耐受軟食（3.3 vs 4.8天）、術後住院天數較短（7.5 vs 8.5天）（皆p≤0.001）。術後第5天前的疼痛評分SPRS組較低（皆p<0.001），而併發症率與病理指標相似。3年無復發存活率（RFS）SPRS為95.2%，CMLS為95.1%（p=0.835）；相對應的整體存活率（OS）分別為97.2%與94.8%（p=0.104）。手術方式並非RFS或OS的獨立預測因子。在現有追蹤期間內，SPRS提供與CMLS相當的腫瘤學結果，同時伴隨較少的術後疼痛與較佳的術後恢復。這些資料支持SPRS作為特定大腸癌病人的可行手術方式。

papers.action: 可考慮對條件適合之大腸癌病人採用SPRS以縮短恢復期，惟長期腫瘤學證據仍待更大樣本、更長追蹤及前瞻性研究證實。

papers.title: Multipathway pharmacological interventions targeting liver-derived immune resistance in colorectal cancer liver metastasis
papers.authors: Chen M, Qin S, Zhan Y, Wang Q
papers.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors provide durable benefit in mismatch repair-deficient colorectal cancer, but most microsatellite-stable tumors remain resistant, particularly in the presence of liver metastases. Immune resistance in colorectal cancer liver metastasis reflects both baseline MSS-CRC mechanisms, including low neoantigenicity, limited T-cell priming and tumor-intrinsic immune exclusion, and liver-specific or liver-amplified mechanisms, including tolerogenic antigen presentation by hepatic resident cells, macrophage-mediated loss of tumor-reactive T cells, and hepatic stromal, vascular and metabolic remodeling. Across early-phase and retrospective studies, responses to checkpoint-based combinations have been observed more often in patients without active liver metastases, but these exploratory subgroup findings do not yet establish independent predictive value or clinical causality. Antiangiogenic agents, multikinase inhibitors, myeloid- and stromal-targeted therapies, innate immune activation, and liver-directed interventions may partially overcome these barriers, but single-pathway strategies have shown limited efficacy. This Mini Review summarizes the mechanisms and clinical evidence of liver-mediated immune resistance and proposes organ-informed, mechanism-matched therapeutic strategies for colorectal cancer liver metastasis.

papers.title: Challenges and opportunities facing inflammatory bowel disease in Sub-Saharan Africa: towards a contextually relevant research and practice agenda
papers.authors: Cooper S, Watermeyer G, Levin D, Mhlaba Z, Davidson K, Bernstein C
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), comprising Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, has traditionally been considered a disease of Western, industrialized countries. Over the past few decades, however, many Sub-Saharan African (SSA) countries have experienced significant increases in cases. Yet, IBD remains highly neglected in SSA with most research conducted in high-income settings and treatment guidelines geared towards these settings. An emerging body of research on the sub-continent is highlighting several unique realities, dilemmas, and priorities facing IBD, and the need for evidence-based approaches that are more locally relevant and contextually tailored. In this viewpoint article we synthesize the challenges facing IBD in SSA and propose a research and practice agenda for addressing these, building on several promising initiatives already under way. Ultimately, we make a call to the international IBD community, researchers, funders, and policymakers to recognize the importance of IBD in SSA and join efforts to remedy global disparities in the quality, accessibility, and equity of IBD care.

papers.title: Inflammatory bowel disease and breast cancer: epidemiological evidence, shared biology, and clinical management
papers.journal_full: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
papers.authors: Han Q, Zhang X, Li S
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE AND DESIGN: This narrative review examines epidemiological, genetic, mechanistic, microbial, and therapeutic evidence concerning inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and breast cancer.
METHODS: Relevant literature was identified through targeted PubMed searches completed through May 2026 and reference-list screening. Evidence was selected for its relevance to epidemiology, candidate mechanisms, microbiome-related pathways, and treatment interactions.
RESULTS: Pooled cohort evidence does not show a significant overall increase in breast cancer risk among patients with IBD. Several inflammatory, stromal, microbial, and endocrine pathways are relevant to both diseases, although most evidence comes from separate study populations and experimental models. Studies of patients with prior malignancy have not shown a clear increase in new or recurrent cancer during commonly used IBD therapies, but few analyses have focused specifically on breast cancer. Microbiome-directed treatments have been studied in IBD and, more recently, in oncology; their value for patients with both diseases is unknown.
CONCLUSIONS: Current evidence does not support classifying IBD as a breast cancer risk state. The main clinical concern is the interaction between treatments for the two diseases, which requires individualized assessment and coordinated gastroenterology and oncology care.

papers.title: Augmenting colonoscopy with artificial intelligence and robotic assistance: a human-factors scoping review toward a task-based shared autonomy paradigm
papers.authors: Manfredi L, Annicchiarico A, Gravante G
papers.abstract: Colonoscopy is central to colorectal cancer prevention but remains a high-demand psychomotor and cognitive procedure, characterized by operator dependency, variable performance, and substantial physical and mental workload. Increasing evidence links procedural quality and safety to clinician-related factors, including musculoskeletal strain, fatigue, and non-technical skills. Concurrently, artificial intelligence (AI) and robotic technologies are emerging as potential tools to address these limitations. We conducted a scoping review with narrative synthesis of literature on human factors, ergonomics, AI, robotic technologies, and shared autonomy in colonoscopy and surgical robotics. Evidence synthesis: Colonoscopy performance remains limited by non-negligible miss rates and variability driven by both technical and human factors. Ergonomic constraints and cognitive workload contribute significantly to operator strain and may affect vigilance and decision-making. AI systems-including computer-aided detection (CADe), diagnosis (CADx), and quality monitoring-have demonstrated improvements in detection metrics and procedural standardisation, although concerns regarding cognitive offloading and potential deskilling persist. In parallel, emerging robotic and soft-robotic platforms aim to enhance navigation, improve procedural ergonomics, and reduce operator musculoskeletal strain, although clinical evidence remains limited. These technologies converge within a task-based shared-autonomy paradigm integrating physical, perceptual, and cognitive augmentation, with different procedural tasks operating at different levels of human-system control. A task-based shared-autonomy framework may provide a coherent model for integrating AI and robotics into colonoscopy while preserving human supervision and clinical judgement. Future developments should prioritise human-centred design, workflow integration, and multidimensional evaluation strategies to ensure safe and effective clinical implementation.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸鏡檢查是大腸直腸癌預防的核心，但仍是高需求的精神運動與認知操作，具有操作者依賴性、表現變異大、且身心負荷顯著等特徵。越來越多證據顯示，操作品質與安全性與臨床醫師相關因子有關，包括肌肉骨骼勞損、疲勞與非技術性技能。與此同時，人工智慧（AI）與機器人技術正逐漸成為解決這些限制的潛在工具。我們針對大腸鏡與手術機器人領域中的人因、人體工學、AI、機器人技術與共享自主進行了範疇性回顧並做敘事性綜整。證據綜整：大腸鏡表現仍受限於不可忽視的漏診率，以及由技術與人為因素共同驅動的變異性。人體工學限制與認知負荷顯著造成操作者勞損，並可能影響警覺性與決策。AI系統——包括電腦輔助偵測（CADe）、診斷（CADx）與品質監測——已顯示能改善偵測指標與流程標準化，但認知卸載與潛在去技能化的疑慮仍然存在。同時，新興的機器人與軟性機器人平台旨在增進導航、改善流程人體工學並減少操作者肌肉骨骼勞損，惟臨床證據仍有限。這些技術匯聚於一個整合生理、知覺與認知強化的任務導向共享自主典範中，不同的流程任務運作於不同程度的人機控制層級。任務導向共享自主框架或可為將AI與機器人整合入大腸鏡檢查、同時保留人類監督與臨床判斷，提供一個一致的模型。未來發展應優先考量以人為中心的設計、工作流程整合與多維度評估策略，以確保安全有效的臨床落地。

papers.title: Revisiting Cell Death in Colorectal Cancer: The Rise of Ferroptosis as a Therapeutic Opportunity
papers.authors: Altamimi A, Elemam N, Kalady M, Talaat I
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a global health concern and a leading cause of cancer mortality, where therapeutic resistance persists as the central barrier to sustained response. Most conventional therapies rely on apoptosis, but CRC frequently resists through p53 alterations, anti-apoptotic BCL-2 upregulation, and drug efflux mechanisms. Here, we explore unconventional cell death pathways, focusing on ferroptosis, as a strategy to overcome apoptosis-dependent therapeutic resistance in CRC. We discussed the molecular mechanisms of ferroptosis, including GPX4 blockade, iron dysregulation, and lipid metabolism remodeling, and emphasized their implications for drug-resistant CRC. Then, necroptosis, pyroptosis, and autophagy were discussed in relation to their crosstalk with ferroptosis. Preclinical models show that ferroptosis inducers (e.g., erastin, RSL3, talaroconvolutin) selectively kill chemoresistant CRC, including KRAS-mutant CRC, and potentiate the efficacy of conventional regimens. The therapeutic duality of autophagy, pyroptosis, and necroptosis in CRC is discussed, with emphasis on ferroptosis's ability to circumvent traditional mechanisms of resistance. Yet, clinical translation is hindered by insufficient pharmacokinetics, systemic toxicity, limited biomarker availability, tumor heterogeneity, compensatory antioxidant pathways, and the need for safer delivery platforms. We propose that ferroptosis is most likely to enter CRC therapy through rational combinations, biomarker-guided patient selection, and tumor-targeted delivery platforms rather than as a stand-alone cytotoxic strategy.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球健康隱患及癌症死亡主因，治療抗性持續是維持治療反應的核心障礙。多數傳統療法依賴細胞凋亡（apoptosis），但CRC常透過p53變異、抗凋亡蛋白BCL-2上調及藥物外排機制產生抗性。本文探討非傳統細胞死亡路徑，聚焦於ferroptosis，作為克服CRC中凋亡依賴性治療抗性的策略。我們討論了ferroptosis的分子機轉，包括GPX4阻斷、鐵代謝失調及脂質代謝重塑，並強調其對抗藥性CRC的意涵。接著討論necroptosis、pyroptosis及autophagy與ferroptosis的交互作用。臨床前模型顯示，ferroptosis誘導劑（如erastin、RSL3、talaroconvolutin）可選擇性殺死化療抗性CRC細胞，包括KRAS突變型CRC，並增強傳統治療方案的療效。文中討論autophagy、pyroptosis及necroptosis在CRC中具雙重治療意義，並強調ferroptosis規避傳統抗性機制的能力。然而，臨床轉譯受限於藥物動力學數據不足、全身性毒性、生物標記可得性有限、腫瘤異質性、代償性抗氧化路徑，以及需要更安全的藥物傳遞平台。我們提出ferroptosis最有可能透過合理藥物組合、生物標記導向的病人篩選及腫瘤標靶傳遞平台進入CRC治療，而非作為單一細胞毒性策略。

papers.title: Robotic colorectal cancer surgery: perioperative and oncological outcomes at a national referral center in Mexico
papers.authors: Aguilar-Romero J, Vela-Sarmiento I, Melchor-Ruan J, Martinez-Said H, Aguilar-Frasco J, Lino-Silva L
papers.abstract: Robotic colorectal surgery is increasingly used for technically demanding pelvic procedures, but contemporary cancer-specific experience from Latin American public oncology centers remains limited. To describe perioperative and pathological outcomes of a robotic colorectal cancer program at a national oncology referral center in Mexico. We retrospectively analyzed 75 consecutive patients who underwent robotic surgery for colorectal malignancy at the Instituto Nacional de Cancerología between June 2024 and March 2026. Colon and rectal cancer were analyzed as separate descriptive cohorts. Major morbidity was defined as Clavien-Dindo grade III or higher within 30 days. Fifty-seven patients (76.0%) had rectal cancer and 18 (24.0%) had colon cancer. No conversion to open surgery occurred (0/75; exact 95% CI 0-4.8%). Median operative time was 290 min (IQR 220-345), estimated blood loss 50 mL (IQR 30-100), and hospital stay 4 days (IQR 3-6). Major morbidity occurred in 13/75 patients (17.3%), reintervention in 12/75 (16.0%), and 30-day readmission in 12/75 (16.0%). Among rectal patients, 54/57 (94.7%) received total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) and 11/54 (20.4%) achieved pathological complete response. The circumferential resection margin was < 1 mm in 8/57 (14.0%). Mesorectal quality was complete in 41/57 (71.9%), nearly complete in 7/57 (12.3%), and incomplete in 9/57 (15.8%). Median lymph-node yield was 9 (IQR 6-12) for rectal cancer and 25.5 (IQR 16.25-32.25) for colon cancer. This series describes robotic colorectal cancer surgery within an established national oncology service, with a case mix dominated by low rectal procedures. The findings provide contemporary perioperative and pathological quality data for continued institutional audit; comparative studies and longer follow-up are required before conclusions regarding relative effectiveness can be made.

papers.title: Diffusion and geographic variation in robot-assisted colon resection after reimbursement in Japan: a nationwide billing-based analysis, 2022-2024
papers.abstract: This study aimed to quantify how rapidly robot-assisted colon resection billing diffused after reimbursement in Japan and whether geographic variation narrowed as uptake expanded. We analyzed National Database (NDB) Open Data for fiscal years (FYs) 2022-2024. The primary outcome was the robot-assisted share of two laparoscopic billing categories for malignant colon tumor resection (robot-assisted and conventional). Variation across treating-institution prefectures was summarized using the interquartile range (IQR) for absolute spread and the coefficient of variation (CV) and Gini coefficient for relative dispersion. Longitudinal analyses included prefectures with unmasked values in all relevant years; FY2024 permitted a complete 47-prefecture cross-section. The national robot-assisted share rose from 3.38% in FY2022 to 11.40% in FY2023 and 19.55% in FY2024. In the common 33-prefecture panel, the IQR widened from 5.73 to 6.61 and 11.79 percentage points, whereas the CV fell from 1.086 to 0.630 and 0.482 and the Gini coefficient from 0.565 to 0.347 and 0.269. Across all 47 prefectures in FY2024, shares ranged from 0.00% to 41.47%; the complete cross-section was more heterogeneous than the restricted longitudinal panel, and the 14 prefectures excluded because of earlier masking had a lower median share (6.83% versus 18.05%). Rapid national growth did not translate into geographically uniform billing-based uptake. Relative dispersion decreased while absolute percentage-point spread widened, so apparent geographic convergence depended on the scale used. Post-reimbursement surveillance should report both dimensions and account for selection introduced by disclosure-related masking.

papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在量化日本健保給付機器人輔助大腸切除術申報後的普及速度，以及隨使用率擴大地區變異是否縮小。我們分析2022-2024財年的全國資料庫（NDB）公開資料。主要結果為惡性大腸腫瘤切除術兩類腹腔鏡申報分類（機器人輔助與傳統）中機器人輔助之佔比。各治療機構所在都道府縣間的變異以四分位距（IQR）衡量絕對離散程度，以變異係數（CV）與吉尼係數衡量相對離散程度。縱貫分析納入所有相關年度均有未遮蔽數值的縣市；2024財年則可進行完整47都道府縣橫斷面分析。全國機器人輔助佔比由2022財年的3.38%上升至2023財年的11.40%、2024財年的19.55%。在共同的33縣縱貫面板中，IQR由5.73個百分點擴大至6.61、再至11.79個百分點，而CV則由1.086降至0.630、再至0.482，吉尼係數由0.565降至0.347、再至0.269。在2024財年全部47個都道府縣中，佔比範圍為0.00%至41.47%；完整橫斷面比受限縱貫面板更為異質，且因早期遮蔽而被排除的14個縣市中位數佔比較低（6.83% 對 18.05%）。全國快速成長並未轉化為地理上均一的申報使用率。相對離散程度下降，但絕對百分點差距擴大，因此表面上的地理趨同與否取決於所用的尺度。給付後監測應同時報告兩種面向，並考量資訊揭露相關遮蔽所引入的選擇性偏誤。

papers.title: Mechanisms of phosphorylation in colitis regulation: PP2Acα as an emerging therapeutic target for inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Wu G, Wang C, Fang C, Li J
papers.abstract: Post-translational modification(PTM) is the terminal regulatory step of gene expression, directly regulating protein function through reversible or irreversible chemical modifications, enabling cells to rapidly respond to internal and external environmental stimuli. Among various post-translational modifications (PTMs), the dynamic balance between phosphorylation and dephosphorylation constitutes the molecular switch for inflammatory signal transduction, and disruption of this balance is an important cause of the persistent non-healing of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The catalytic subunit of protein phosphatase 2 A, PP2Acα(encoded by the PPP2CA gene), as the predominant serine/threonine phosphatase in the body, accounts for more than 70% of serine/threonine phosphatase activity in mammalian tissues and has been proven to play a key role in inflammatory diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis. However, the specific regulatory network, targets, and mechanisms of PPP2CA in IBD have not yet been systematically elucidated. This review aims to summarize the regulatory role of PTMs (especially phosphorylation/dephosphorylation) in IBD, deeply explore the structure and function of PPP2CA and its potential mechanisms in intestinal inflammation, and propose core scientific questions for future research, providing a new theoretical perspective for IBD therapeutic strategies targeting PPP2CA.

papers.title_zh: 磷酸化調控在結腸炎中的機轉：PP2Acα作為發炎性腸道疾病的新興治療標的
papers.abstract_zh: 轉譯後修飾(PTM)是基因表現的最終調控步驟，透過可逆或不可逆的化學修飾直接調控蛋白質功能，使細胞能迅速對內外環境刺激做出反應。在各種轉譯後修飾中，磷酸化與去磷酸化之間的動態平衡構成發炎訊息傳遞的分子開關，此平衡失調是發炎性腸道疾病(IBD)持續無法癒合的重要原因。蛋白磷酸酶2A的催化次單元PP2Acα（由PPP2CA基因編碼）是體內最主要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸磷酸酶，佔哺乳動物組織中絲胺酸/蘇胺酸磷酸酶活性的70%以上，已被證實在類風濕性關節炎等發炎性疾病中扮演關鍵角色。然而，PPP2CA在IBD中具體的調控網絡、標的分子與機轉尚未被系統性闡明。本綜述旨在總結PTM（尤其是磷酸化/去磷酸化）在IBD中的調控角色，深入探討PPP2CA的結構與功能及其在腸道發炎中的潛在機轉，並提出未來研究的核心科學問題，為針對PPP2CA的IBD治療策略提供新的理論視角。

papers.title: SIRT3-Dependent Actions of Berberine: From Molecular Therapies to Toxicity
papers.journal_full: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
papers.authors: Shackebaei D, Miraghaee S, Farhadi F, Akbarzadeh A, Yarmohammadi F
papers.abstract: Berberine, an alkaloid with broad bioactive properties, exerts its pleiotropic effects by modulating SIRT3, a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase. This review examines the dual role of SIRT3 as a target of berberine in the management of various disorders while also addressing its associated toxicological profiles. The antihyperglycemic effects of berberine are mediated through SIRT3 inhibition, which promotes hyperacetylation of complex I subunits, degradation of MPC1, an increased AMP/ATP ratio, AMPK activation, and suppression of PEPCK1, collectively resulting in the inhibition of gluconeogenesis. In contrast, the hypolipidemic, cardioprotective, and hepatoprotective effects of berberine are associated with SIRT3 activation, which facilitating adipose tissue remodeling, enhancing β-oxidation in NAFLD, promoting lipophagy in diabetic cardiomyopathy, and mitigates doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity. Furthermore, berberine exhibits antitumor duality, exerting contrasting effects in colorectal cancer and hepatoma models, and demonstrates versatile mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming in polycystic ovarian syndrome. Notably, ocular toxicity associated with berberine has been linked to SIRT3 inhibition in photoreceptors cells. Overall, the therapeutic versatility of berberine is fundamentally associated with its context-dependent modulation of SIRT3, positioning it as a promising mitochondrial epigenetics modulator for conditions such as metabolic syndrome, NAFLD, and DCM. However, its therapeutic application must be carefully balanced against organ-specific toxicity risks.
papers.title_zh: 小檗鹼之SIRT3依賴性作用：從分子治療到毒性
papers.abstract_zh: 小檗鹼是一種具有廣泛生物活性的生物鹼，其多效性作用是透過調節SIRT3（一種粒線體NAD+依賴性去乙醯酶）來發揮。本綜述檢視SIRT3作為小檗鹼治療標的在多種疾病管理中的雙重角色，同時探討其相關毒理學特性。小檗鹼的抗高血糖效果是透過抑制SIRT3所介導，促使複合體I次單元過度乙醯化、MPC1降解、AMP/ATP比值上升、AMPK活化，以及抑制PEPCK1，共同導致糖質新生受抑制。相反地，小檗鹼的降血脂、心臟保護及肝臟保護效果則與SIRT3活化有關，促進脂肪組織重塑、增強NAFLD中的β氧化作用、促進糖尿病心肌病變中的脂噬作用，並減輕doxorubicin誘發的心臟毒性。此外，小檗鹼展現抗腫瘤雙重性，在大腸直腸癌與肝癌模型中呈現相反作用，並在多囊性卵巢症候群中展現多樣化的粒線體代謝重編程。值得注意的是，小檗鹼相關的眼毒性已被連結至光受器細胞中SIRT3的抑制。總體而言，小檗鹼的治療多樣性根本上與其對SIRT3的情境依賴性調節有關，使其成為代謝症候群、NAFLD及糖尿病心肌病變等疾病中具潛力的粒線體表觀遺傳調節劑。然而，其治療應用必須審慎權衡器官特異性毒性風險。
